# Research Question Coverage

Development evidence only.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **When do promising signals fail?** (`failure-conditions`) | mixed (3 studies): invalid, mixed, negative | mixed (2 studies): mixed, negative | mixed (2 studies) | mixed (3 studies): invalid, mixed, negative, unscored | mixed (2 studies): mixed, negative, unscored |
| **Can candidate-side semantic evidence improve query-only retrieval?** (`candidate-evidence`) | mixed (6 studies): invalid, mixed, negative, unscored | mixed (3 studies): mixed, negative | uncovered | mixed (2 studies): invalid, mixed | uncovered |

| **How reliable must a generated reference be?** (`reference-reliability`) | uncovered | uncovered | mixed (4 studies): mixed, positive | uncovered | positive (1 study) |
| **Can model responses provide useful ranking evidence?** (`response-evidence`) | uncovered | uncovered | positive (2 studies) | mixed (2 studies): mixed, negative, unscored | mixed (6 studies): mixed, negative, positive, unscored |
